audit.purpose: Chinese classification fitness of synthetic translations/adaptations; NOT a bilingual literal-translation gold corpus

bilingual_caveats.note: The English is licensed provenance, not runtime transaction evidence. Requested actions may change during adaptation; independent Chinese review must agree with proposed route or exclude the case. Do not claim every retained sentence is a faithful literal translation.
